# Three secrets diverge in one merge. Each can take its own side: the incoming
# version with `sesam reveal <path>`, the edit with `sesam seal <path>`.

sesam-repo admin base.txt theirs.txt edited.txt

cp $TMPDIR/base.txt s
cp $TMPDIR/base.txt t
cp $TMPDIR/base.txt u
exec sesam add s t u --group admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add s t u'

exec git checkout -b topic
cp $TMPDIR/theirs.txt s
cp $TMPDIR/theirs.txt t
cp $TMPDIR/theirs.txt u
exec sesam seal
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'topic: change s t u'

exec git checkout master
exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'ours: add bob'

! exec git merge topic
cp $TMPDIR/edited.txt s
cp $TMPDIR/edited.txt t
cp $TMPDIR/edited.txt u
exec sesam status
stdout '3 diverged'

# A seal naming only t still refuses: s and u have not been decided.
! exec sesam seal t
stderr '2 secret\(s\) changed both here and in git'

# Theirs for s, the others are kept and named.
exec sesam reveal s
stderr 'discarded your unsealed edits in 1 secret'
stderr 'sesam:   s'
stderr 'kept 2 edited secrets'
exec cat s
stdout 'THEIRS'

# Ours for t and u.
exec sesam seal t u
exec git commit -m 'merge topic'
exec sesam show .sesam/objects/s.sesam
stdout 'THEIRS'
exec sesam show .sesam/objects/t.sesam
stdout 'MY-EDIT'
exec sesam show .sesam/objects/u.sesam
stdout 'MY-EDIT'
exec sesam verify
stderr 'Integrity: ok'

-- base.txt --
BASE
-- theirs.txt --
THEIRS
-- edited.txt --
MY-EDIT
